title: Breakfast Quesadilla
description: Scrambled egg and cheese folded into a crisp tortilla.
substitutions: Add a spoonful of leftover vegetables or beans.

steps.text: Melt butter in a skillet and scramble 2 eggs until barely set; move them to a plate.
Put the tortilla in the skillet. Sprinkle cheese over half, add eggs, and fold.
Cook 2 minutes per side until crisp and melted. Serve with salsa if desired.

storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly and use within 3–4 days.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Tacos
description: Dump-and-go salsa chicken that shreds easily for tacos.
substitutions: Use mild or hot salsa to control heat.
Serve over rice instead of tortillas.

steps.text: Put chicken in the slow cooker. Pour 2 cups salsa over it and sprinkle with cumin and chili powder.
Cover and cook on LOW for about 4 hours, until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken directly in the sauce and serve in tortillas.

title: Hamburger Potato Casserole
description: Layers of seasoned ground beef, thin potatoes, and creamy sauce.
substitutions: Cream of chicken soup can replace mushroom.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Brown the ground meat and drain excess fat.
Layer half the potatoes, half the meat, and half the soup mixture in a greased 9x13-inch dish; repeat.
Cover tightly and bake 45 minutes. Uncover, add cheddar, and bake 15 minutes more until potatoes are tender.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Rice Casserole
description: Creamy rice, broccoli, and cheddar baked until bubbly.

ingredients.item: cream of mushroom or chicken soup, 10.5 oz

steps.text: Mix cooked rice, broccoli, soup, milk, garlic powder, and 1 cup cheddar.
Spread in a greased baking dish and top with remaining 1/2 cup cheddar.
Bake 25–30 minutes until hot and bubbly.
